description: Turns a command like "/ifso 0x... 20 on 2026-12-01" into a plain preview and the UNSIGNED data to create that if-so payment from the sender's own wallet: two transactions (USDG approve, then create) or one gasless authorization to sign. This server never signs, never holds a key and never sends anything; the sender reviews and signs in their own wallet. Same checks as the site's build step.

altRefundTo.description: Second refund address, used if the sender cannot receive USDG.

cancellable.description: Let the sender cancel before anything happens (default false).

linkKey.description: For a claim link: the address derived from the link secret. Keep the secret yourself; never send it.

recipient.description: Recipient, when the command says link and you want a fixed recipient instead.

referee.description: Referee wallet for a referee condition, when not typed in the command.

sender.description: The wallet that sends the USDG and signs.

text.description: The command, e.g. "/ifso 0x... 20 on 2026-12-01" or "/challenge 0x... 10 if nvda closes above 200 by friday". See ifso_list_conditions.

tzOffsetMin.description: The person's UTC offset in minutes for dates (e.g. 240 for UTC+4). Stock deadlines always use New York time.

name: ifso_prepare_payment
title: Prepare an IFSO payment (unsigned)
